label: Updated 8 AM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: CJ CUP Byron Nelson Leader
items.text: Si Woo Kim leads THE CJ CUP Byron Nelson at -18 through 1 hole after rounds of 64 and 60, five shots ahead of five players at -13.

items.headline: Spieth's Birdie Surge
items.text: Jordan Spieth shot a bogey-free 62 featuring six straight birdies on the back nine to reach 12-under, currently T6, six behind the leader.

items.headline: Im's Ace & Eagle
items.text: Sungjae Im aced the par-3 7th and eagled the 9th to post a 61, climbing to -13 and sitting T2 just behind Si Woo Kim.
